name: Arlington County, Virginia (United States)
description: White field with thin dark blue horizontal bands along the top and bottom, charged with the county logo, a stylised A of dark and light blue shapes.
history: Arlington County, or simply Arlington, is a county in Virginia. The flag was adopted on 22 January 2022 (adopted on 22 January 2022 after a year-and-a-half process with a county logo review panel, replacing the 1983 flag with the county seal, according to Flags of the World).
